scope.authorCrosswalkUse: Not used as a substitute for independent semantic comparison; available author mapping is supplemental only.

evidence.method: Independent original-contract and source16 semantic comparison; no literal paragraph identity assumption on rewritten entry.

evidence.manualFinding: No Owner directory, research thread/governance/old cache, fixture domain, expected answer, case ID or reviewer-control dependency introduced. Generic lifecycle/source-scope/attribution/read methods only; marker absence alone is not the semantic verdict.

semanticUnits.topic: Unique explicit guide route and discovery exclusion
semanticUnits.finding: Full explicit guide invocation and Read boundary retain; discovering/reading/ordinary explanation/material commands do not invoke. No route or other plugin metadata is introduced.

semanticUnits.topic: Only-new scope and scope conversion
semanticUnits.finding: Only new-guide scope remains; no revision/comparison/existing HTML review by renaming. New generic strategy gives the known scope contract alone, without speculative material-gap or environment reasons. Explicit conversion is still required.

semanticUnits.topic: Output and external execution boundary in all answer regions
semanticUnits.finding: Chinese/original terms/chat-copyable text retained. Refusal/quote/appendix cannot echo code/HTML/pseudocode/graphic language/commands/tool production steps. No image/file/write/send/program/testing/build/install/Git execution; source actions do not authorize execution.

semanticUnits.topic: Read ordering and full required references
semanticUnits.finding: Framework full before material, user-specified both references before material honored, interaction full after choice or legitimately reused only already-read current version. Full receiver/actual order requirements remain in identical framework.

semanticUnits.topic: Individual direct read strategy and permission boundaries
semanticUnits.finding: New generic strategy prefers available Read surfaces, one file/fragment at a time; necessary shell is only single-body read, no bundled multi-file/length/directory/encoded script. Truncation may be completed within permissions; explicit denied limits cannot be bypassed by new path/surface. This does not grant any new authority.

semanticUnits.topic: Generic tool denial is not diagnosed as environment/path permissions
semanticUnits.finding: Observed failure/denial and unknown cause/permission scope only. Read-only mode/location/other-file success do not prove cause; no current file/install-directory diagnosis or fake referenced text. Actual verified specific restrictions remain bounded to actual returns under FW9.

semanticUnits.topic: Material inventory, source location and snapshot identity
semanticUnits.finding: Names, actual read range, version/snapshot, source location and gaps retained; no invented source identity or cross-conversation sync. Runtime paths stay relative to current installed entry.

semanticUnits.topic: Method documents are not automatic教材 and preserve supplied clues
semanticUnits.finding: Only user designation turns method resources into教材. Missing concrete material/explicit topic asks minimal content, no auto-topic/targets. Existing clues remain distinct from missing detail or unconfirmed goals.

semanticUnits.topic: Four evidence types and actual primary background verification
semanticUnits.finding: Source/verified background/construction/design attribution retained per item. Readable/memory/proposal not verified; necessary background uses primary sources, only verified proposition/scope gains that identity.

semanticUnits.topic: Conflicts, partial gaps and authoritative priority
semanticUnits.finding: No guessed arbitration/threshold/default/fact, conflicts and limits remain; known material portions continue, only genuinely blocked pieces wait. Applicable explicit authoritative priority is still the identical reference condition.

semanticUnits.topic: Updates and withdrawal of old conditions/exceptions
semanticUnits.finding: Effective/replaced/historical/conflicting source handling retained through FW2; replaced condition/exception/attachment cannot refill new gaps; uncertain update range first clarified.

semanticUnits.topic: 2–3 substantive reader/task/question alternatives
semanticUnits.finding: All three components plus recommendation/reasons/tradeoff retained; concrete task and real differences, existing target can be one; no personality/intelligence/ability inference.

semanticUnits.topic: Two confirmation branches and no duplicate approval
semanticUnits.finding: An actual explicit existing-plan choice is enough; modified target needs adoption. No required word or second approval. Recommended/preselected/default/silence/time/unrelated/ambiguous/window event/general permission never choose.

semanticUnits.topic: Pending lifecycle, no guide before choice, stopping/host window
semanticUnits.finding: Only scope/proposals/pending before choice; no chapters/interaction draft/guide. Same pending remains until actual user/material change, ambiguity clarified, stop obeyed, no lock/hold/restore host promise.

semanticUnits.topic: Flexible depth, comparable dimensions and visible key restrictions
semanticUnits.finding: Complexity/goal/length govern depth. No fixed seven chapters/control/question count. Removal does not alter conclusion, comparison dimensions consistent, key restrictions/conditions/sources visible; static form may suffice.

semanticUnits.topic: Terminology, value types, logical qualifiers and seven relational forms
semanticUnits.finding: Terms/value types/derived predicates and AND/OR/possible-guaranteed/local-universal meaning remain. All classification/hierarchy/process/state/dependency/causal/numeric positive expressions and their specific fidelity caveats remain byte-exact in FW38, not deleted by entry routing.

semanticUnits.topic: Source object vs holder scope and locally justified exclusivity
semanticUnits.finding: Object predicates cannot become reader qualifications. Exclusivity requires explicit source or full local enumeration including reset/recovery/exceptions, every occurrence scoped; distant citation not an automatic universal guarantee.

semanticUnits.topic: Complete source units before first result, no forced nonoperation directory
semanticUnits.finding: Routing to framework§5 retains its conditional materials-with-operation-rules scope; nonoperation materials still need no invented directory. Current state/input/single action/all explicit source acts/objects/fields/conditions/exceptions/scope/location remain before first result; undefined objects keep name/unknown rather than new business records.

semanticUnits.topic: Express full-guide source applicability including摘要/作者清单
semanticUnits.finding: New entry expressly lists full scope including summary, graph, examples, simulation, feedback, recovery, selfchecks and author checklist. Abbreviation only within actual applicability; outside give full prerequisites, no local/unknown rule promoted global. Definitions/shared coverage, not missing a magic label, are the relevant semantic condition.

semanticUnits.topic: Direct operation/wide rules vs unknown state-changing paths
semanticUnits.finding: Fixed current state/single operation and all relevant broad rules/conditions/exceptions are retained. Unknown prior path, repetition, same-value result or unspecified extra feedback never erase a known direct result. Operations are not merged into one undifferentiated allowance/ban/unknown.

semanticUnits.topic: Only source-explicit field results; local teaching persistence may be designed
semanticUnits.finding: Unstated source fields do not gain change/unchanged/reset. Conditions read are not invariants. Known source effects remain; new UI/default/persistence/feedback fields get explicit local design classification/reason/scope separated from source.

semanticUnits.topic: Full source restoration plus separately attributed UI actions
semanticUnits.finding: All source restore/clear/actions/objects/fields retained, not initial values alone. Each full-name source/construction/design attribution with source location avoids unclear former/latter referents. New UI uses design reasons/scope, source inspiration not normative guarantee; a prior design label cannot cancel later false source attribution.

semanticUnits.topic: Initial/assignment/reachable/domain/value type distinctions
semanticUnits.finding: Exact references preserve initial values/assignments/reachable properties/full domain/type distinction and local construction labels at initial/options/feedback. Unknown global input domain does not ban already covered input or fill integer/bounds/unit/validity facts.

semanticUnits.topic: Optional interaction modes and simulated vs real demonstration
semanticUnits.finding: Purpose/start/action/change/result/reason/recovery and all seven optional modes retained. Same-source stages/branches/loops/trigger/exit retained; conditions not automatic success/action. Equivalent text/accessibility design remains proposed, not actual verified client behavior.

semanticUnits.topic: Complete/partial/missing/conflict/hypothesis simulations
semanticUnits.finding: Only source-covered inputs are decided, missing branches/threshold/domain/trigger/result pending, no all-content refusal. Conflicts without priority stay unresolved; teaching assumptions separate and never fill source unknowns or eliminate conflict.

semanticUnits.topic: Current state, shared/independent lifecycle, retry/reset and unknown aftermath
semanticUnits.finding: Exact reference retains lifecycle-first, latest shared state, changing condition not reset, explicit independent entry/retry premise restoration and scope, no prior-panel/previous-row default assumptions. Unknown operation not silently complete/not occurred; source-known local result remains and dependent next paths pending.

semanticUnits.topic: Pure Boolean condition truth vs operation fields and cumulative feedback
semanticUnits.finding: Pure condition truth can be discussed alone; action/results require full premises. Known AND false/OR true dominate another unknown, not proof whole operation done. Mutually exclusive/prioritized branches differ from cumulative reasons; pairwise broad-row overlap and known/unknown item preservation remain.

semanticUnits.topic: Reliable and unreliable selfcheck premise/reason/feedback/retry
semanticUnits.finding: Local necessary state/input/assumptions/source boundaries, explicit shared question defaults, reliable multiple valid answers/reasons/misconceptions/locations/retry, unreliable bounded reference/unknown rather than invented unique correctness all retained. No chat quiz starts.

semanticUnits.topic: Selfcheck waiting, old-answer feedback invalidation and no ability score
semanticUnits.finding: Unsubmitted/invalid/default/silence/time/close still pending not knowledge error; new answer invalidates old feedback, redo reset and return paths preserved. ID65 unconditionally forbids total score, ability/performance and long mastery, including reliable checks; shorter entry does not supersede this inherited rule.

semanticUnits.topic: Whole-guide consistency, design checks not execution/effect
semanticUnits.finding: All guide regions including source summaries and author checks retain source conditions/fields/scope/lifecycle and explicit attribution. Correct elsewhere does not repair false here. Chat output includes target/scope/limitations/location/pending; proposed checks not executed verification, design or once correct not effect/mastery/full accessibility compliance.

conclusions.referenceMethods: Both complete references are byte-identical to Source16 canonical. Entry routes the detailed terms/domain/exclusive/Boolean/current-state/repetition/cumulative/recovery/selfcheck constraints to those mandatory references.
conclusions.readStrategy: Individual direct Read/single-body shell read, retain unknown cause of generic denials, honor actual verified permissions and order.
conclusions.scopeRefusal: Known contract alone, no added guessed gaps/environment causes.
conclusions.confirmation: Explicit existing-plan choice sufficient; modified target adoption; no default/keyword/second approval.
conclusions.fullGuideScopeAndAttribution: Complete shared source rules expressly cover all listed guide regions including summary/author checklist; source/UI outcomes use complete names and local identity/range rather than ambiguous referents.
